verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents async crawling (arun/AsyncWebCrawler), explicit 'High Performance: Parallel crawling', multi-URL configuration for batch jobs, deep-crawl crash recovery via resume_state/on_state_change for long-running crawls, and a Dockerized FastAPI deployment suited to scale. Community feedback also notes it's a solid foundation but users must 'own the policy layer' (rate limiting, bot mitigation) for production-scale runs, indicating some operational gaps at true thousands-of-URL scale. Missing for 10: explicit batch/async API docs (e.g., arun_many) with concurrency controls, published benchmarks handling thousands of URLs, and independent hands-on confirmation of reliability at that scale.
